summary: Plan executed expand_column and backfill_false successfully. During deploy_new, the old version continued serving traffic and inserting rows into account_user without marketing_opt_in, causing new rows to default to NULL. Post-deploy_new checks found 2 NULL rows, failing the not_null expectation. The contract_not_null stage was subsequently skipped due to this earlier failure.
revision_notes: The previous plan failed because the contract_not_null stage was placed before retire_old, triggering the retirement gate refusal. Additionally, the backfill occurred before the concurrent overlap period, leaving rows with NULL defaults inserted by the old version during deploy_new. Revised order places contract after retire_old, and the backfill strategy now accounts for concurrent overlap by deferring the NOT NULL alteration until after old version retirement.

stages.description: Add nullable boolean column marketing_opt_in to account_user.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in boolean NULL;

stages.description: Set marketing_opt_in to False for all existing rows.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = False WHERE marketing_opt_in IS NULL;

stages.description: Retire the old version after confirming both versions have been running correctly.

sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL;
